abilities.name: garden-abilities/list-posts
abilities.description: Retrieves a paginated list of posts with metadata including title, status, author, dates, excerpt, and comment count. Useful for getting an overview of site content.

abilities.name: garden-abilities/site-health-status
abilities.description: Retrieves the WordPress Site Health status including critical issues, recommended improvements, and passed tests. Enables AI assistants to proactively diagnose site problems and surface security/performance concerns.

abilities.name: garden-abilities/woo-system-status
abilities.description: Retrieves WooCommerce system status including environment details, database information, theme compatibility, store settings, and detected issues. Use to diagnose WooCommerce problems and verify server requirements.

abilities.name: garden-abilities/woo-orders-summary
abilities.description: Retrieves a summary of WooCommerce orders including counts by status, 7-day sales metrics, and recent orders. Provides a quick business pulse for AI agents to monitor store performance.
